name: dead-page-navigation-cleanup
title: Retire dead page-navigation helper and stale fallback docs
description: Remove the unreferenced frontend page-navigation helper that still fabricates synthetic page_context payloads, then realign tests and canonical docs with the actual live runtime owner chain.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 audit found that page-navigation.ts was no longer imported by production frontend code, but it still fabricated synthetic page_context/navigation fallback payloads and was referenced by tests/task docs as if it were a live runtime boundary. The helper and its isolated test were deleted the same day so the new SaaS runtime no longer carries that dead seam.
